name: Modern Dental Group Limited
summary: Modern Dental Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in production, distribution, and trading of dental prosthetic devices in Europe, Greater China, North America, Australia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Fixed Prosthetic Devices; Removable Prosthetic Devices; and Others. It offers restorative dental procedures, such as crowns, bridges, and implants. The company also produces full and partial dentures with and without metal frameworks. In addition, it offers orthodontic devices, sports guards, anti-snoring devices, raw materials, clear aligner, and dental equipment; and services for educational events and seminars.
